snippet.title: Disconnected — Official Steam Wishlist Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist now available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4346240/Disconnected/
.
.
.

What would you do if your biggest audience witnessed your own death?
In Disconnected, you play as Robex, a successful streamer who becomes trapped during a live urbex exploration inside a property that was supposed to be abandoned.

The connection drops, the doors slam shut, and your only window to the outside world is your smartphone screen. To escape, you won’t just have to solve puzzles—you’ll have to manage the chaos of your chat and survive a presence that does not tolerate uninvited guests.

The house has an owner, and William Grahame hasn’t forgotten how to deal with intruders. Move silently, mute your phone, and make sure you don’t draw his attention while searching for a way out. If he sees you, the stream will end sooner than expected.

Your smartphone is more than just an interface—it’s your only way out. Use the camera to reveal anomalies and the flashlight to guide your steps through the darkness. Remember: if the battery runs out, your stream—and your life—run out with it.

What started as simple content for your channel hides a story of family madness. Discover photos, documents, and hidden messages that uncover the Grahame family tragedy and the dark reason why, out of all places, you ended up here.

There’s no pause. No rest. He knows you’re inside, and the chat wants more blood. Keep moving, because in this house, standing still is the fastest way to be disconnected forever.

“My house is your house!”

.
.
.
